decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down at E569-07 (radio and CMMS agree). The likely repair is 13:30. The stope has 164 t at 10.5 g/t, about 55 oz. Este has a nearly empty stockpile and trucks that are not limiting, so extra inflow counts. LH-10 is an idle spare at the workshop, 0.49 h away. It loads at 27.5 t/h, so it can clear the 164 t within the loading blocks, and no producing place or development heading loses a loader. The LH-03 conflict is unconfirmed (confidence 0.4), so per CONFIRM-01 I am moving nothing there and asking the area chief. I am not activating a reserve, because no stope has stopped.
